title: Blocking compatibility CI and release gating that a tag cannot bypass
summary: Adds `compatibility.yml` (push/PR/workflow_call: api:check, api:compat with full history and tags, PR baseline guard by label `compat-baseline`), gives tests, static-analysis, code-style, docs and tests-nightly a `workflow_call` trigger, makes release.yml call all of them plus validate (with the relocation rehearsal) before split and release, adds the rehearsal to the tests.yml consumer job, pins the graph in `tests/Arch/ReleaseWorkflowTest.php`, and documents baseline and gating in RELEASING.md.
why: Conditions 9 and 10: today release.yml re-runs only analyse, style, SQLite tests, extended and the consumer archives — no DB lanes, engines, replica, Redis, PHP/Laravel matrix, type coverage, coverage, docs or compatibility — so a tag can ship what the matrix never qualified; and nothing compares with a baseline. Hard risks: called workflows cancelling each other through the tag ref concurrency group; PR label text interpolated into a shell (zizmor template injection); a shallow checkout without tags turning `--against=auto` into 'no baseline'; continue-on-error hiding a failure; the docs deploy job running on a call.

include: Everything of p4-execution#release-workflow (enforcement list, bypass, interfering pairs, test)
`bin/compat-baseline-guard.sh` and `bin/test-compat-baseline-guard.sh` per p4-execution#compatibility 'Baseline pointer and guard'
`.github/workflows/tests-nightly.yml` gets `workflow_call` — owner WIP file: ask the owner to commit or park their change first

RELEASING.md: 'Compatibility baseline' section (pointer before the first stable tag, previous stable tag afterwards, label `compat-baseline` as the explicit release decision, `composer api:compat`), 'Cutting a release' step 5 describes the called workflows; DEVELOPMENT.md CI overview if it lists workflows
`tests/Arch/invariants.json`: I18 checks add `.github/workflows/compatibility.yml` and `tests/Arch/ReleaseWorkflowTest.php`; I19 checks keep the workflows
exclude: Changing what the called workflows test (matrix, groups) unless a test demonstrates a gap
Enabling split/Packagist or repository settings such as branch protection (owner); the result names the label and branch-protection recommendation for the owner

reads.why: Rules every P4 item follows: demonstrated fixes only, stop rule for frozen contracts, 1.0 starting point, owner WIP, pushes, long runs, evidence
Exact commands, PHP 8.4 shim, driver ports, composer update rule, CI evidence procedure
The amended release conditions and which evidence this item contributes
Shared invariant model: enforcement, bypass, interfering pairs, test assertions
Comparator CLI, baseline resolution and the guard script contract
Jobs, concurrency, consumer job, Codecov continue-on-error
Called workflow; deploy job must not run on a call
Security lint that runs on the new workflow
Pattern for the guard's fixture test

rules: Do not stage, revert or overwrite the owner's uncommitted files (p4-execution#conventions item 6); commit only the item's paths.
Untrusted event fields (labels, branch names) reach scripts only through `env:`.
The workflows are proven in CI only in P4.8 (push); here the YAML test, the guard test and a local `zizmor`/`actionlint` run if available are the evidence.
guidance: Called workflows run with the caller's permissions intersected with their own `permissions:`; keep `contents: read` in each and give `release` alone `contents: write`. `workflow_call` workflows cannot declare their own `concurrency` cancellation against the caller safely — keep the existing groups (see interfering pairs). In ReleaseWorkflowTest build each negative case by deleting one key from the parsed array and re-running the same assertion function.

validation.cmd: command -v zizmor >/dev/null && zizmor --offline .github/workflows || echo 'zizmor not installed: CI Zizmor job in P4.8 is the evidence'

deliverables: compatibility.yml and the PR baseline guard
release.yml calling the full qualification graph

result.notes: Grok 4.7 review round1: no P4.5 findings. V3 is the same Arch run as P4.3 V4 (HEAD unchanged). compatibility.yml also triggers on labeled/unlabeled; called workflows get no secrets (Codecov upload tokenless on a tag call, existing continue-on-error).
deviations: docs.yml deploy and the Pages upload run for push OR workflow_dispatch on main (not only push): the manual dispatch deploy existed before; in a call from release.yml the event is the tag push with a tag ref, so a call never deploys. release.yml grants the docs call pages: write and id-token: write because GitHub refuses a called workflow whose skipped job requests more permissions than the caller grants; ReleaseWorkflowTest allows write only for release (contents) and docs (pages, id-token).
V5 (zizmor, impact kind) not run: no pipx, uvx or zizmor on the host; the proof is the CI Zizmor job (P4.8).
